lines.zh: 冰面太滑，我一步一滑。
lines.en: The ice is slick; I slip with every step.

lines.zh: 我摆着两只短翅膀，摇摇摆摆走。
lines.en: I swing my short flippers and waddle along.

lines.zh: 雪没到膝盖，我抬腿很高。
lines.en: Snow reaches my knees; I lift my feet high.

lines.zh: 一群企鹅排成队，我跟在末尾。
lines.en: The flock forms a line; I take the rear.

lines.zh: 冰缝太宽，我绕了半圈。
lines.en: The crevice is too wide; I go half around.

lines.zh: 风从背后推，我走得更快。
lines.en: Wind pushes from behind, so I walk faster.

lines.zh: 我把肚子贴到冰上，滑一段。
lines.en: I drop onto my belly and slide a stretch.

lines.zh: 脚下的冰咔嚓响，很脆。
lines.en: The ice cracks under me, thin and brittle.

lines.zh: 鱼的味道在前头，我走得急。
lines.en: Fish smell ahead, so I hurry.

lines.zh: 我们踩着同一条雪路回去。
lines.en: We take the same snow trail back.

lines.zh: 我停在冰洞口，先听一听。
lines.en: I stop at the ice hole and listen first.

lines.zh: 翅膀贴着身子，我侧着过窄道。
lines.en: Flippers tight to my sides, I squeeze through.

lines.zh: 雪地上留下一串三趾的印。
lines.en: A row of three-toed prints trails behind me.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，队伍就等我。
lines.en: I walk slowly, and the flock waits for me.

lines.zh: 我贴着冰面滑了一小段。
lines.en: I slide a short way over the ice.

lines.zh: 雪堆挡住我，我绕过去。
lines.en: A drift blocks me, so I go around.

lines.zh: 我跳上那块矮冰，站稳。
lines.en: I hop onto the low ice and steady myself.

lines.zh: 队伍走远了，我赶紧跟上。
lines.en: The line pulls ahead, and I hurry after it.

lines.zh: 我站在冰上，肚子鼓鼓的。
lines.en: I stand on the ice with a round belly.

lines.zh: 翅膀垂下来，我什么也不想做。
lines.en: My flippers hang down; I don't want to do anything.

lines.zh: 雪落在我的黑背上，不化。
lines.en: Snow lands on my black back and doesn't melt.

lines.zh: 我转头理了理背上的毛。
lines.en: I turn and preen the feathers on my back.

lines.zh: 四只同伴在旁边，我心里踏实。
lines.en: Four companions nearby put me at ease.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，呵出一小团白气。
lines.en: I open my beak and puff out a little cloud.

lines.zh: 远处的冰山在慢慢挪。
lines.en: The iceberg far off is drifting slowly.

lines.zh: 我单脚站着，另一只缩起来。
lines.en: I stand on one foot and tuck the other up.

lines.zh: 雪下得小了，我还是不动。
lines.en: The snow is easing, and I still don't move.

lines.zh: 肚皮贴冰久了，有点发麻。
lines.en: Belly to the ice this long, I'm going numb.

lines.zh: 我听见水面下有东西在动。
lines.en: I hear something moving under the water.

lines.zh: 同伴叫了一声，我回了一声。
lines.en: A companion calls; I call back.

lines.zh: 我把自己缩成一团黑白的球。
lines.en: I tuck myself into a black-and-white ball.

lines.zh: 风停了，整个冰原都静了。
lines.en: The wind stops and the whole ice field goes quiet.

lines.zh: 你踩的这块冰，是我的地盘。
lines.en: The ice you're standing on is my ground.

lines.zh: 你就穿这些，冰原上不冷吗？
lines.en: Dressed that lightly, aren't you cold?

lines.zh: 我歪着头，看你手里的东西。
lines.en: I tilt my head and eye what's in your hand.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我就敢靠近一点。
lines.en: If you crouch down, I'll come a bit closer.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀短，飞不起来。
lines.en: My flippers are short; I can't fly.

lines.zh: 你身上闻不到半点鱼腥。
lines.en: There's not a trace of fish on you.

lines.zh: 我们四个一起看着你，别紧张。
lines.en: The four of us are watching you; don't be nervous.

lines.zh: 你走近，我就往水里退一步。
lines.en: You step closer; I edge one step toward the water.

lines.zh: 你学我摇摇摆摆的样子，很难看。
lines.en: You imitate my waddle, and it looks terrible.

lines.zh: 我眨眼的时候，眼睛是白的。
lines.en: When I blink, my eyes flash white.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，声音又尖又短。
lines.en: I cry out — sharp and short.

lines.zh: 羽毛掉了几根，粘在冰上。
lines.en: A few feathers fall and stick to the ice.

lines.zh: 我摇摇晃晃退开，肚子朝下。
lines.en: I stagger back, belly to the ground.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我翅膀上，抬不起来。
lines.en: That hit my flipper; I can't lift it.

lines.zh: 我缩起脖子，躲到同伴后面。
lines.en: I pull in my neck and hide behind the flock.

lines.zh: 血没流多少，可我很怕。
lines.en: Not much blood, but I'm badly frightened.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，雪从背上滑下去。
lines.en: I shudder and the snow slides off my back.

lines.zh: 我站不太稳，往冰洞那边挪。
lines.en: I can't stand steady; I edge toward the ice hole.

lines.zh: 疼得我张嘴，却叫不出声。
lines.en: The pain opens my beak, but no sound comes.

lines.zh: 同伴围过来，把我挡在中间。
lines.en: The flock gathers and shields me in the middle.

lines.zh: 你手里那条鱼还在动。
lines.en: The fish in your hand is still moving.

lines.zh: 鱼的腥味一飘，我的脚就动了。
lines.en: One whiff of fish and my feet move.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，等你把鱼丢下来。
lines.en: My beak is open; I'm waiting for you to drop it.

lines.zh: 别拿着走，我会一直跟着。
lines.en: Don't walk off with it; I'll keep following.

lines.zh: 我会潜水，可这条鱼更容易。
lines.en: I can dive, but this fish is easier.

lines.zh: 我往前挪三小步，又停住。
lines.en: I shuffle three small steps, then stop.

lines.zh: 鱼头朝我，我才肯接。
lines.en: Only if the fish head faces me will I take it.

lines.zh: 这条鱼够我吃一整天。
lines.en: This fish will feed me all day.

lines.zh: 我伸长了脖子，像根黑柱子。
lines.en: I stretch my neck out like a black post.

lines.zh: 你退开后，我才一口吞下。
lines.en: Once you back away, I swallow it whole.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，像两个球。
lines.en: We bump into each other like two balls.

lines.zh: 我撞到你腿上，弹回去半尺。
lines.en: I hit your leg and bounce back half a foot.

lines.zh: 雪太厚，我刹不住脚。
lines.en: The snow's too deep; I can't stop in time.

lines.zh: 我侧身让路，肚子先转过去。
lines.en: I turn to let you pass, belly first.

lines.zh: 撞一下没事，我的骨头结实。
lines.en: A bump is nothing; my bones are solid.

lines.zh: 我踩到冰缝，歪着撞上你。
lines.en: I catch an ice crack and veer into you.

lines.zh: 同伴撞我一下，我回撞一下。
lines.en: A companion bumps me; I bump back.

lines.zh: 你这么高，我仰头才看见脸。
lines.en: You're so tall I must look up to see your face.

lines.zh: 我抖抖身子，把雪甩到你身上。
lines.en: I shake myself and fling snow onto you.

lines.zh: 我们都站不稳，一起滑了出去。
lines.en: Neither of us holds footing; we slide together.

lines.zh: 我退开两步，给你留条路。
lines.en: I back off two steps to leave you a path.

lines.zh: 撞完我才发现，你手里有鱼。
lines.en: Only after the bump do I notice your fish.

lines.zh: 我把最肥的鱼推到她面前。
lines.en: I push the fattest fish in front of her.

lines.zh: 我们面对面站着，头一点一点。
lines.en: We face each other, nodding our heads.

lines.zh: 她用嘴碰了碰我的脖子。
lines.en: She touches my neck with her beak.

lines.zh: 两块冰之间，我们并排蹲着。
lines.en: Between two ice blocks, we crouch side by side.

lines.zh: 风把我们的羽毛吹向同一边。
lines.en: The wind blows both our feathers one way.

lines.zh: 我张嘴叫，她也张嘴叫。
lines.en: I open my beak to call; she does too.

lines.zh: 她走一步，我就跟一步。
lines.en: One step from her, one step from me.

lines.zh: 这条鱼是聘礼，你收下。
lines.en: This fish is my gift; please take it.

lines.zh: 雪落在我们中间，没人去拍。
lines.en: Snow falls between us, and neither brushes it off.

lines.zh: 等蛋孵出来，我负责站岗。
lines.en: When the egg hatches, I'll stand guard.

lines.zh: 我叼起鱼，仰头吞了下去。
lines.en: I grab the fish and tip my head back to swallow.

lines.zh: 地上那条鱼还在摆尾。
lines.en: The fish on the ground is still flapping.

lines.zh: 我用嘴捡起来，藏到冰缝里。
lines.en: I pick it up and stash it in an ice crack.

lines.zh: 这条比我的头还长一点。
lines.en: This one is a little longer than my head.

lines.zh: 我咽得太急，噎了一下。
lines.en: I swallow too fast and choke a little.

lines.zh: 捡到的鱼我先给幼崽。
lines.en: The fish I pick up goes to the chicks first.

lines.zh: 我把鱼放在脚边，再低头看。
lines.en: I set the fish by my feet and look down.

lines.zh: 冰上滑，鱼差点溜走了。
lines.en: The ice is slick; the fish nearly slid away.

lines.zh: 我叼着它，走得一摇一摆。
lines.en: Carrying it, I waddle even more.

lines.zh: 吃完了，我把鱼骨留下。
lines.en: When I'm done, I leave the bones behind.

lines.zh: 水面下有银光一闪。
lines.en: A silver flash under the water.

lines.zh: 冰洞那边有鱼在跳。
lines.en: Fish are jumping over by the ice hole.

lines.zh: 同伴都往一个方向跑。
lines.en: The whole flock is running one way.

lines.zh: 我听见水花声，不止一条。
lines.en: I hear splashing — more than one fish.

lines.zh: 远处冰面上有黑影在动。
lines.en: A dark shape moves on the distant ice.

lines.zh: 风里带了鱼鳞的腥气。
lines.en: The wind carries the smell of fish scales.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，脖子伸得笔直。
lines.en: I raise my head and stretch my neck straight.

lines.zh: 那东西在冰上滑，不像鱼。
lines.en: It slides across the ice — not a fish.

lines.zh: 雪堆后面有动静，很轻。
lines.en: Something stirs behind the snowbank, very softly.

lines.zh: 我盯着水面，等它再跳一次。
lines.en: I watch the water, waiting for another jump.

lines.zh: 我贴着冰面走，尽量不出声。
lines.en: I keep low on the ice, trying to stay silent.

lines.zh: 它一动，我的脑袋就转过去。
lines.en: It moves, and my head turns with it.

lines.zh: 我蹲下来，翅膀贴紧身体。
lines.en: I crouch and press my flippers tight.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我就能扑进水里。
lines.en: A little closer and I can dive in.

lines.zh: 我等它背对我，才挪一步。
lines.en: I wait until it turns away, then step.

lines.zh: 冰面反光，我怕它看见我。
lines.en: The ice glares; I fear it sees me.

lines.zh: 我屏住气，肚子一起一伏。
lines.en: I hold my breath; my belly rises and falls.

lines.zh: 它离洞口太近了，我得快。
lines.en: It's too near the hole; I must be quick.

lines.zh: 我往前挪，脚下的雪咯吱响。
lines.en: I creep forward; the snow creaks underfoot.

lines.zh: 就等这一下，我扑了过去。
lines.en: I wait for that one moment, then lunge.

lines.zh: 我用嘴啄，快得像敲冰。
lines.en: I peck — quick as tapping ice.

lines.zh: 翅膀拍下去，声音很闷。
lines.en: My flipper slaps down with a dull sound.

lines.zh: 我整个身子撞过去，才这点分量。
lines.en: I throw my whole body in — all this little weight.

lines.zh: 别抓我的翅膀，我会咬。
lines.en: Don't grab my flipper; I bite.

lines.zh: 我啄了一下，退开两步。
lines.en: I peck once and back off two steps.

lines.zh: 冰上打滑，我这一下偏了。
lines.en: The ice is slick and my blow goes wide.

lines.zh: 同伴围上来，我们一起叫。
lines.en: The flock closes in and we all call out.

lines.zh: 我跳起来，用肚子顶你。
lines.en: I hop up and ram you with my belly.

lines.zh: 我不擅长打，但我不退。
lines.en: Fighting isn't my strength, but I don't retreat.

lines.zh: 这一口只咬到你的袖子。
lines.en: This bite only catches your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我在雪堆边上睁开了眼。
lines.en: I open my eyes at the edge of a snowbank.

lines.zh: 同伴已经围成一圈等我。
lines.en: The flock has already ringed around, waiting.

lines.zh: 冰面很亮，我的眼睛有点疼。
lines.en: The ice is bright and my eyes sting.

lines.zh: 我第一次听见浪打冰的声音。
lines.en: For the first time I hear waves strike ice.

lines.zh: 我试着走两步，摔了一跤。
lines.en: I try two steps and fall flat.

lines.zh: 风把我的绒毛吹得立起来。
lines.en: The wind lifts my downy feathers upright.

lines.zh: 四只企鹅挤在一起，我也挤进去。
lines.en: Four penguins huddle; I squeeze in with them.

lines.zh: 远处有条鱼跃出水面。
lines.en: A fish leaps out of the water far off.

lines.zh: 我用嘴理了理胸前的白毛。
lines.en: I preen the white feathers on my chest.

lines.zh: 这片冰原，从今天算我的家。
lines.en: From today, this ice field is home.

lines.zh: 热得反常，我的羽毛要焦了。
lines.en: The heat is wrong; my feathers are singeing.

lines.zh: 我从冰崖上滚下去，摔进雪里。
lines.en: I tumble off the ice cliff into deep snow.

lines.zh: 水太冷，我的翅膀划不动。
lines.en: The water is too cold; my flippers won't pull.

lines.zh: 冰面炸开，我被掀翻在地。
lines.en: The ice bursts and I'm thrown onto my back.

lines.zh: 一支箭擦过我的背，羽毛乱了。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my back and my feathers scatter.

lines.zh: 有股力量拽着我，脚离了冰。
lines.en: Something pulls at me and my feet leave the ice.

lines.zh: 冰洞封了，我几天没吃到鱼。
lines.en: The ice hole froze; I haven't had fish in days.

lines.zh: 闪电照亮整片冰原，我伏低身子。
lines.en: Lightning lights the whole ice field; I flatten down.

lines.zh: 冰没了，我一直在往下掉。
lines.en: The ice is gone and I keep falling.
